G1_unambiguity.justification: The complementary-mode requirement and the explicitly defined penalty uniquely determine which assignments are valid and preferred.

G2_completeness.justification: The essential constraints and formats are present, though the input bounds are described indirectly and the valid range or distinctness of each vessel identifier is not stated explicitly.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Assigning complementary modes to every recorded pair is equivalent to requiring conflicting endpoints to use different shifts, and minimizing the given binary-weighted penalty is exactly lexicographic minimization of the assignment.

G4_naturalness.justification: The scenario is readable and coherent, although phrases such as “minimum requirements and maximum capacities described in the system overview” are somewhat artificial and indirect.
